translations.web: The trees set out to anoint a king over themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’
translations.bsb: One day the trees set out to anoint a king for themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’

translations.asv: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive-tree, Reign thou over us.
